title: Measuring Risk, Not Harm: Detecting Psychological Harm Risk Factors in LLM Conversations
abstract: arXiv:2611.06806v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Psychological harms from interactions with large language models cannot be monitored directly because they may emerge over repeated interactions and depend strongly on subjective individual user context. We propose measuring risk, not harm: detecting observable AI behaviors that constitute risk factors for psychological harm at the AI response level and aggregating these signals to support longitudinal monitoring. We operationalize eight such behaviors and construct a synthetic multi-label corpus of 47,062 AI responses and 373,873 response-factor labels, with targeted human annotations for validation and evaluation. We then compare trained embedding-based classifiers, direct LLM judging, and a classifier--judge cascade. All detectors are model-agnostic and operate only on LLM outputs, requiring no access to internal model states. We apply these detectors to several out-of-distribution human-AI conversation data sets from prior research.

translated_title: 测量风险而非伤害：检测大语言模型对话中的心理伤害风险因素
translated_abstract: 与大语言模型交互所产生的心理伤害无法被直接监测，因为这类伤害可能在多次交互中逐渐显现，并且高度依赖于用户个体的主观情境。我们提出“测量风险而非伤害”的方法：在AI回复层面检测可观察的、构成心理伤害风险因素的AI行为，并聚合这些信号以支持纵向监测。我们将八种此类行为进行了操作化定义，构建了一个包含47,062条AI回复和373,873个回复-因素标签的合成多标签语料库，并进行了针对性的人工标注用于验证和评估。随后，我们比较了训练的基于嵌入的分类器、直接使用LLM评判、以及分类器-评判器级联三种检测方案。所有检测器都是模型无关的，仅作用于LLM输出，无需访问模型内部状态。我们将这些检测器应用于来自先前研究的多个分布外人机对话数据集。
tldr: 该论文提出通过在AI回复层面检测可观察的心理伤害风险因素行为并聚合信号以实现纵向监测的新范式，构建了大规模合成多标签语料库并比较三种检测方案，且所有检测器均模型无关、只需访问LLM输出。
